correctness.rationale: A complete combinatorial classification of all independent support types gives two disjoint threefold joins and 3m^2 cross-edges. The integral relative long exact sequence gives H_1 as an oriented-edge augmentation (with parity twist), H_2 as the two join tensor lattices (with graded factor permutation), and no other reduced homology. The spanning-tree quotient proves the wedge homotopy type. Exact finite-group invariant arguments and six explicit traces give both quotient Betti vectors. Finite modular ranks and signed cellular Lefschetz tests for m=2,3,4 corroborate, but are not used as a proof over all m.

value.rationale: The six-cycle is the minimal even cycle with two alternating maximum independent triples and three diametrical cross-link types, yielding a natural mixed-dimensional homology problem missed by forest-only lexicographic methods. The full integral wreath/dihedral action is stronger than Betti counts and exposes genuinely different homology for rotation and full-symmetry quotients for every m≥2. The infinite-family clean module classification is structurally motivated by the independence-set decomposition and useful for symmetry-sensitive topological combinatorics.
